figurative_meaning_en: Repetition of the same words or phrases tediously
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার বক্তৃতায় সবসময় একই প্রতিশ্রুতি, যেন ফাটা রেকর্ড বাজানো হচ্ছে।
সভায় সে ফাটা রেকর্ড বাজানোর মতো একই গল্প বলতে থাকল।
example_sentences_in_english: His speech is full of the same promises, like playing a broken record.
In the meeting, he kept repeating the same story like a scratched record.
history: This idiom originates from the era of vinyl records, where a crack would cause the needle to skip and repeat the same segment endlessly, reflecting mid-20th century technology in Bengali urban and political contexts.
note: The idiom highlights frustration with monotonous repetition, often in political or rhetorical settings.
